newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hilton to operate $100 mln hotel in Eilat, Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hilton to operate $100 mln hotel in Eilat, Israel.

text.p: Hilton International said on Sunday it has been selected to operate a 450 room hotel in the Israeli Red Sea resort of Eilat.
The $100 million hotel is scheduled to open by the end of 1998.

This follows last week's announcement that Hilton International will manage by the end of this year a hotel in Beer Sheva, the biggest city in southern Israel. Scheduled for opening in 1999 are a resort hotel in the Dead Sea and a convention hotel in the northern port of Haifa.

Hilton currently operates a 600 room hotel in Tel Aviv and plans to open a hotel in Jerusalem next year. The hotel chain plans to increase the number of hotel rooms in Israel from 600 to 2,250 within the next couple of years.
"We strongly believe in the economic and tourist strength of Israel and the eastern Mediterranean countries," said Peter George, chief executive of Labroke Plc, which owns Hilton International.

"We predict a rapid growth in the world's leisure tourism in general and in Israel in particular," George said at the ceremony where the agreement between Hilton International and the hotel's Israeli developers was signed.
Hilton is one of several major international chains increasing its presence in Israel.

Sheraton International Inc, a subsidiary of ITT Corp, signed a memorandum of understanding to form a hotel management partnership with Koor Tourism Enterprises; Radisson SAS Hotels recently entered the Israeli market, forming a strategic partnership with the seven Moriah hotels; and Interncontinental and Hyatt are building news hotels in Israel.
